# four programs, one problem, three answers
#
# Regenerate with:  python -m tools.make_traces
# Do not edit by hand: tests/test_docs_traces.py compares this file with a
# fresh run of the code it shows.

## the same inputs through every program

'correct answer' is algorithms.balanced.reference, the O(n^3) oracle.

+----------+----------------------------+----------------+-------------------------+----------------------------+---------+-----------+
| input    | correct answer             | submitted loop | verdict                 | submitted recursion        | verdict | this repo |
+----------+----------------------------+----------------+-------------------------+----------------------------+---------+-----------+
| 'aabbb'  | 4 ['aabb']                 | 0 []           | wrong                   | 4 ['aabb']                 | ok      | ok        |
| 'aabbc'  | 4 ['aabb']                 | 2 ['bc']       | wrong                   | 4 ['aabb']                 | ok      | ok        |
| 'abcabc' | 2 ['ab', 'bc', 'ca']       | 2 ['bc']       | same length, wrong list | 2 ['ab', 'bc', 'ca']       | ok      | ok        |
| 'aabbaa' | 4 ['aabb', 'abba', 'bbaa'] | 4 ['bbaa']     | same length, wrong list | 4 ['aabb', 'abba', 'bbaa'] | ok      | ok        |
| 'ababab' | 6 ['ababab']               | 6 ['ababab']   | ok                      | 6 ['ababab']               | ok      | ok        |
| 'aabb'   | 4 ['aabb']                 | 4 ['aabb']     | ok                      | 4 ['aabb']                 | ok      | ok        |
| ''       | 0 []                       | 0 []           | ok                      | 0 []                       | ok      | ok        |
+----------+----------------------------+----------------+-------------------------+----------------------------+---------+-----------+

## the dominators, the same way

+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| array                    | correct answer                              | submitted loop                              | submitted recursion                         |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| [3, 1, 3, 2, 3, 4, 3, 3] | Dominator(value=3, indices=(0, 2, 4, 6, 7)) | Dominator(value=3, indices=(0, 2, 4, 6, 7)) | Dominator(value=3, indices=(0, 2, 4, 6, 7)) |
| [1, 1, 2, 2]             | None                                        | None                                        | None                                        |
| [1, 2, 3]                | None                                        | None                                        | None                                        |
| [2]                      | Dominator(value=2, indices=(0,))            | Dominator(value=2, indices=(0,))            | Dominator(value=2, indices=(0,))            |
| []                       | None                                        | None                                        | None                                        |
| [None, None, 1]          | Dominator(value=None, indices=(0, 1))       | Dominator(value=None, indices=(0, 1))       | None                                        |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
